title: Design record, review and documentation for the overhaul
description: Impeccable detector, fresh finish review, regenerated DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json, README/frontend report/journal updates with real evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given the finished build, then desktop 1440 and mobile 390 captures in light and dark are reviewed and the reviewer verdict is reported honestly.
Given the new world, then DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json describe the shipped tokens and components.
verification: Impeccable detector: 0 findings. Fresh finish review of 36 captures returned disposition 'fix' with 7 material items. After the fix batch (all test-first, mutation-checked), the same reviewer's verdict pass scored fixes 1-6 resolved: passage-level evidence jump, matching dark mark, Activity hides internal jobs, faded thread edge, Attach PDF instead of dead controls, chip kept with its word. Non-material residual: the mark can start about one glyph late, a limit of pdf.js text-layer geometry also seen in pdf.js find highlighting. Fix 7 (DESIGN.md) goes to impeccable-documenter. Final: Vitest 338/338, ESLint 0, tsc clean, Playwright 8/8 on a fresh e2e DB. impeccable-documenter rewrote DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json from the built code. The stale teal and system-font world was replaced, which closes fix 7. It reported drift. Two items were fixed test-first: (a) a ModelSwitcher save failure raised toast.error, and now stays inline in the open menu (2 mutations caught); (b) the --evidence token was unused because the reader hard-coded its value, so the token now has a single value in both themes and the reader reads it. The rest was accepted as stock shadcn: the dark sidebar-primary blue is overridden where used, chart tokens are unused, and status tints cover job and model badges as documented. Final: Vitest 339/339, ESLint 0, tsc clean, build passing, Playwright 8/8 on a fresh e2e DB.
